messages.subject: Webinar: Employment law update - Autumn 2025
messages.plaintextBody:
Hello,

Join our complimentary 90-minute webinar covering the latest tribunal decisions, the new duty to prevent sexual harassment, and changes to settlement agreement practice. 18 November, 12:30pm. 1.5 CPD hours.

Register online to reserve your place.

Bryson Legal Training
